recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast portrait of a musician seated in a weathered industrial space. The subject sits on a stool holding an acoustic guitar against a distressed white-washed brick wall. The composition uses a mix of raw, hand-scrawled display text and clean, small-scale tracklist typography integrated into the wall's texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the lower right quadrant to balance large-scale top-right and bottom-left typography.
The rough texture of the brick wall mirrors the distressed, hand-drawn quality of the display lettering.
Cool blue and grey tones in the environment contrast with the warm wood of the acoustic guitar.
coreInvariants: Low-angle lighting from a single side window

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated in the lower right, occupying approximately one-third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar acts as the central dark mass and primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top-right title, moves down to the subject, then across to the bottom-left artist name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of the brick wall as negative space to house tracklists and titles.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool greys and muted blues (wall, denim, shadows).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm browns and ambers (guitar body, boots).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high tonal contrast between the dark guitar and the pale wall.

letterConstructionRules: Display text features uneven stroke widths and rough, jittery edges.
Script elements use a continuous, fluid motion with varying pressure.
Tracklist text is a clean, all-caps sans-serif with high transparency to appear painted on the wall.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters in the main title have exaggerated, sharp terminals.
Artist name features a loopy, connected script with a large initial 'M' and 'W'.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Raw, aggressive block lettering paired with a more personal, fluid signature-style script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, personal feel of the artist's name.
Matches the gritty, industrial feel of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with a mullet hairstyle wearing a white t-shirt and blue jeans, sitting on a wooden stool holding a dark sunburst acoustic guitar. He is looking away from the camera. The background is a large, weathered, white-washed brick wall in a dim room with light coming from a side window. High film grain, desaturated colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large hand-drawn block lettering in the top right corner. Add a signature-style script in the bottom left corner. Place two columns of small, clean, all-caps sans-serif text on the brick wall, one in the top right and one in the bottom left, using a 'multiply' or 'overlay' blend mode to let the brick texture show through.

verificationChecks: Is the brick texture visible through the tracklist text?
Does the guitar stand out as the warmest element in the frame?
Is the film grain consistent across the entire image?
Are the two hand-drawn styles distinct from each other?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the brick wall weathering
Level of desaturation in the blues/greens
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title wording
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic lighting on the subject's face and arms.
Ensure the guitar strings are rendered clearly.
Verify that the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the overall mood is somber and industrial.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated industrial portrait with layered, textured typography that mimics the environment's grit.
